programs.desc: A relationship columnist on the brink of losing her job makes a bet with a self-proclaimed matchmaker who guarantees he'll find her perfect match.

programs.desc: Helen, director of Las Fotos Project, empowers teen girls of color through photography; nicknamed The Mother of Las Fotos, she's honored with a surprise engagement party by Lacey and the Party Planners.

programs.title: The Way Home
programs.desc: When Nick joins Kat on her search for more information about Elliot's mother in the 1920s, the two realize they may be in over their heads.

programs.title: The 355
programs.desc: CIA agent Mason "Mace" Brown joins forces with a rival German agent, a cutting-edge computer specialist and a Colombian psychologist when a top-secret weapon falls into the hands of a group of mercenaries. Together, the four women embark on a breakneck mission to save the world while staying one step ahead of a mysterious figure who's tracking their every move.

programs.title: Red
programs.desc: After surviving an assault from a squad of hit men, retired CIA agent Frank Moses (Bruce Willis) reassembles his old team for an all-out war. Frank reunites with old Joe (Morgan Freeman), crazy Marvin (John Malkovich) and wily Victoria (Helen Mirren) to uncover a massive conspiracy that threatens their lives. Only their expert training will allow them to survive a near-impossible mission -- breaking into CIA headquarters.
